properties.description:
Combined browser feedback 3 and 4. Add a See in dependency graph action to the TypeScript text editor right-click context menu for supported type declarations, including interfaces. Open the existing dependency graph focused on the selected type; resolve the actual declaration rather than guessing from its name. Support the editor text and expression presentations.

Move Go to declaration from its autocomplete-panel icon into the same context menu. In this same task, remove the nested type/model declaration entries currently shown under TypeScript files in Repositories: editor context-menu navigation replaces that entry point. Preserve the underlying model data and graph capability, and do not remove unrelated repository children such as checks or UI component entries.
properties.title: Open type dependency graphs from the editor context menu and simplify Repositories
